sub: A simple plan from day one to the final review

steps.title: Week 1: Settle in
points: Meet their manager and a buddy
steps.tip: Write the goals down. You will review them in week 12.

steps.title: Weeks 2-4: Learn the basics
steps.tip: Small wins early build confidence fast.

steps.title: Weeks 5-8: Own a project
steps.tip: Ownership is what interns remember most.

steps.title: Weeks 9-11: Deliver
steps.tip: A short presentation gives them something for their CV.

steps.title: Week 12: Review
steps.tip: Great interns are your future graduate hires.

cta_sub: Save this plan and adapt it to your team.
post_title: How to Structure a 12-Week Internship Programme

captions.linkedin:
How to structure a 12-week internship programme.

Week 1: settle in. Tools, a buddy and 2 or 3 written goals
Weeks 2-4: learn the basics with small, real tasks
Weeks 5-8: own one clear project
Weeks 9-11: deliver it and present to the team
Week 12: review the goals and talk about what comes next

A clear structure is the difference between an intern who makes tea and one who makes an impact.
